messages:
carmen: Quick RFC follow-up: we still see tenants getting revoked and then resurfacing with full throughput because leases leak across shards. Need a reconciliation approach that is cheap and robust.
vik: Can you describe the leak? Is it tokens already refilled on other pools or schedulers granting before revoke visibility?
carmen: Both. When a high-traffic tenant is revoked, some scheduler shards still have tokens or grant new leases before the revoke propagates. Result = eviction churn and noisy fairness metrics.
noah: Proposal: probation-first + reconcile sweep. On revoke write a small sequenced tombstone. Edges consult local LRU cache; on miss they route the tenant to probation instead of fast-path. Meanwhile a async reconciler job scans token buckets for tenants with a revoke_seq bump and zeroes or flags leaked tokens.
vik: Sounds good. Reconciler needs to be rate-limited and idempotent. If we brute-force zero everything we might harm legit tenants. Suggest reconciler do a best-effort delta: if leaked tokens > threshold then apply throttle and emit alert.
carmen: Agreed. Also add a bloom filter at edges to avoid KV reads for tenants with no revokes recently. On revoke we add the tenant to a small push list so edges prime caches; misses still fall back to probation+async read.
noah: Tombstone schema: key `revoke:{tenant}` value `seq|severity|shortcode`. Compare seq numerically in cache. Retract = higher seq with severity=clear.
vik: Reconciler sketch:
```
1) poll recent revokes stream
2) for each tenant with seq bump, query shard-token-summary (aggregated view)
3) if leaked_tokens_ratio > 5% -> issue targeted decrement or mark tenant as blocked in scheduler and alert ops
4) log reconciliation event with before/after token counts
```
carmen: We need metrics: reconcile-run-duration, tenants-affected, avg leaked_tokens_ratio, reconciler-actions-per-minute, probation-entry-rate. Dashboards and an alert if reconcile-run-duration > 30s or tenants_affected > 100 in 5m.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary plan: enable probation routing + small reconciler run to 10% edge nodes at 04:00 UTC for 1h.
noah: Failure modes: stale seq ordering, reconciler race with retracts, and KV storm if many revokes. Mitigations: monotonic seq per-tenant, reconciler checks seq again before applying changes, and reconcile backoff with batching.
vik: Playbook: during canary ops can pause reconciler, retract a tombstone by writing higher seq with severity=clear, or force-evict tenant if thrash persists. Also have a manual override to restore tokens if we detect false-positive mass-block.
carmen: Action items: vik -> micro-RFC with reconciler thresholds and backoff; noah -> prototype bloom filter + reconciler stub; ops -> draft playbook and dashboards. Start probation-only; do not hard-deny in canary.
noah: I'll also add a chaos test that simulates fanout fully dropped and measure time-to-suppress under reconciler-only path.
carmen: Good. Keep the rollout conservative. We'll sync results next infra meeting.
